learning_outcomes.text: Defines the basic concepts of information technologies.
Explains the working principle of computer and logic of an operating system, defines computer hardware and software.
Gains a broad and robust understanding of Microsoft Office applications such as word processor, spreadsheet and presentation programmes.
Defines the basics of programming, CAD and algorithms.
Uses network and internet technologies, has basic knowledge about data security and ethical considerations.

syllabus_topics: Definition of computer, history and functions.
Computer technology - the computer's basic operations.
Installation of the Windows operating system (description and application).
Introduction to programming, graphics applications (CAD) algorithms.
bibliography: Basic Information Technologies I-II, Anadolu University, 2015
